newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said rates stabilised today after falls last week due to increased demand from non-bank financial institutions.

"The market was directionless for most of the session but a few big institutions borrowed funds in late trading," one trader said. "It seems they intend to lend the funds on the treasury bill repurchase market due to high rates there."
"Market sentiment was weak today," a second trader said. "The rates are likely to move in a narrow range in the next few days."
